message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Run Tests
on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - '**'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Setup Vite+
        uses: voidzero-dev/setup-vp@v1
        with:
          cache: true
          run-install: true

      - name: Check Build
        run: vp run build:prod

      - name: Lint
        run: vp run lint

      - name: Test
        run: vp run test
",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs on every pull_request push and has no concurrency control, so repeated pushes to the same PR leave obsolete runs consuming runner time. The P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE pattern applies: runs represent the same workflow and PR, and a newer push supersedes older checks. The change is scoped per workflow+PR via ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}, so distinct PRs are isolated (no shared cancellation group) and this is not release/deployment work. All existing steps (checkout, setup-vp with its existing cache, build, lint, test) are preserved unchanged, with no new permissions, secrets, network access, or privileged actions, so build/test coverage for the tip of each PR is retained.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}
